historical_record.description: The building was the Lebanon Presbyterian Church, with Sunday School classroom space. The City Planning Commission approved, with a condition, using the church's Sunday School classrooms on weekdays for a parent-cooperative nursery school of no more than 24 children.
Photographed, showing the United Presbyterian Church.

Noe Valley Ministry, which took up AIDS education after a member fell ill and in October 1987 ran a public series on how the epidemic bore medically, politically and spiritually on the city; it had hosted the two-day Left/Write writers' conference in February 1981.
Phase one of the renovation of the Noe Valley Ministry building began, starting with exterior repainting and window repairs before interior remodeling.
The Lebanon Presbyterian congregation, organized in 1881, bought this lot in 1884 and dedicated its church here in 1888.
Renovation of the Noe Valley Ministry was ongoing, including a new front door, a wheelchair ramp and front-yard planting.
The renovation of the Noe Valley Ministry building, begun in 1978, was complete by October 1980.
The Noe Valley Co-op Nursery School, a parent cooperative started by a group of parents in 1968, opened here on January 15, 1969.
People Against Nuclear Power, an anti-nuclear coalition in the Abalone Alliance, opened an office in the Noe Valley Ministry.
Casa El Salvador, a Central American human-rights group, opened a second office at the Noe Valley Ministry, 1021 Sanchez St., because its headquarters at 3557 20th St. had grown crowded.
Kadeka Dances for Kids moved into the Noe Valley Ministry here. with a new office, holding an open house March 21, 1986.

On April 27, 1996 more than 90 volunteers from the Christmas in April project renovated five areas of the Ministry building. The work included painting, cleaning and carpentry for ongoing roof repairs.
In September 1996 the Ministry building was finishing a $140,000 renovation of its roof and exterior.
The Noe Valley Ministry, a church and community center, has occupied the church building since 1977.

unknowns: Later issues (1996, 1999) give 1886 as the year the church was built.
